column1: # Phase 5 ordered item 3 follow-up: the region-parallel scheduled-tick loop's
# golden run parameters.
# NOT a vanilla dump: what a fire schedules is `30 + nextInt(10)` from a
# `RandomSource` whose state belongs to the server, and the partition is this
# engine's. `ctest -R region_tick` replays every row below through the real
# `BlockTickQueue`, the real canonical sort and the real `RegionScheduler`,
# dispatching each region's range through `run_block_tick_position`'s shape,
# and compares the whole trace line for line — so an entry sorted into the
# wrong region, a range that swallowed a neighbour's work or a dispatch in the
# queue's raw order cannot land. `tests/fixtures/block_tick` owns the same
# queue on the serial arm and the rules' own streams; this pin owns the
# partition.
# `ticks` is how many world ticks the run advanced the queue through (one
# `advance()` each), `lanes` the lane count the checked-in trace came from
# (the parallel arm for every `laneStable yes` run, one lane for the run that
# crosses a region boundary) and `laneStable` whether the trace at one lane
# and at four lanes must be identical — it is required of every run whose work
# cannot cross a boundary inside one tick, and the `edge` run is the one that
# can, where the difference is the residue docs/PHASE5.md §5 documents and the
# tool prints rather than pins.
# `schedules`/`due`/`plans`/`regionRows`/`dispatches`/`drops`/`writes`/`reads`/
# `draws`/`units`/`states` are the counts of those trace rows, `maxRegions` the
# largest region set one tick planned, `endNow`/`endPending`/`endChunks` the
# queue's own state after the last tick and `worldHash` the whole world's FNV-1a
# over the box the run touched (the A/B's correctness half: the two lane counts
# leave the same world). `rows` is the trace's length.
